51 weeks and 5 days = 51*7 + 5 = 357 + 5 = 362 days.  
1460 is a leap year (divisible by 4, pre-1582 rules).  
From 05-07-1460 (May 7, 1460):  
Days in May after May 7: 31 - 7 = 24 days.  
Remaining days in 1460 after May: June–Dec = 30+31+31+30+31+30+31 = 214 days.  
Total days left in 1460 after May 7: 24 + 214 = 238 days.  
362 - 238 = 124 days into 1461.  
1461 is not a leap year (1461 mod 4 = 1).  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31 = 31+28+31 = 90 days.  
124 - 90 = 34 days into April.  
April has 30 days, so 34 days into April = May 4.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1461-05-04
